operations.summary: Read the administrator-defined CNAME host name or prefix
operations.summary_zh: 读取管理员自定义的 CNAME 主机名或前缀
operations.description: Platform session only; a tenant session answers 403 permission_denied. kind site needs sites.manage, line-group node_scheduling.manage. site holds a complete host name (shop gives shop.<CNAME domain>); line-group holds a prefix (gd gives gd-xxxxxxxx.<CNAME domain>, at most 54 characters). Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen. Errors: cname_label_invalid 400, cname_label_reserved 400, cname_label_taken 409, cname_label_follows_package 409 (a site that shares the CNAME of its package).

operations.summary: Set the administrator-defined CNAME host name or prefix
operations.summary_zh: 设置管理员自定义的 CNAME 主机名或前缀
operations.description: Platform session only; a tenant session answers 403 permission_denied. kind site needs sites.manage, line-group node_scheduling.manage. site holds a complete host name (shop gives shop.<CNAME domain>); line-group holds a prefix (gd gives gd-xxxxxxxx.<CNAME domain>, at most 54 characters). Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen. Errors: cname_label_invalid 400, cname_label_reserved 400, cname_label_taken 409, cname_label_follows_package 409 (a site that shares the CNAME of its package). Setting a site name re-allocates the CNAME of that site at once (a new generation, DNS synchronised, the old record retired). A line group prefix only shapes CNAMEs allocated later. An empty label clears the value.
